summary: Read a string of uppercase English letters whose length is from 0 to 10^4. Inside one contiguous piece, a letter is distinctive when it appears exactly once in that piece. Add, across every nonempty piece, how many distinctive letters it holds. Pieces with the same text but different endpoints are counted apart. The total may be very large, so reduce it modulo 10^9 plus 7 and write the remainder.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
